# Runtime notices

These unmodified license texts preserve the notices already distributed with
RegMapWorkbench 0.3.4 in AppSuite. The 0.3.5 runtime uses the same Qt 6.10.2,
MinGW GCC 13.1.0, winpthreads and pinned QXlsx/yaml-cpp dependencies.
Only text line endings are normalized by Git. ElaWidgetTools, Font Awesome and
ZeroSlack notices and replayable patches are installed separately under
`licenses/ElaWidgetTools`.

These files accompany the runtime libraries; they do not change the libraries'
licenses or authorize removal of their upstream attribution.
